question: From what form does Brahma's lotus-seated power unfold?
premises: this Brahma is seated on lotus
lotus awakens part of own power
forms run from auspicious Śiva to Brahma
inference: This Brahma, seated on the lotus of awakening of a part of his own power, takes those forms from the auspicious Śiva form finally to the Brahma form.
plain_english: This Brahma, seated on the lotus of awakening of a part of his own power, takes those forms from the auspicious Śiva form finally to the Brahma form.
